Succeed with either an Astronomy roll or a Hard Know (half 
EDU) roll and go to 234. Fail, and you can wait for help at 
256, or you can try to get out by walking. If you walk, choose a 
direction: for North, go to 246; for East, go to 213; for South, 
go to 235; for West, go to 283.
